hints.title: Zero Bound Constraint
hints.text: For ones count to be at least zeros squared, total zeros cannot exceed roughly two hundred because two hundred squared exceeds string length limits.

hints.title: Zero Position Indexing
hints.text: Collect all indices of zeros in an array to instantly skip consecutive blocks of ones.

hints.title: Interval Math per Zero Count
hints.text: For each starting index i and count of zeros z, compute the minimum required total length and count valid right endpoints before the next zero appears.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numberOfSubstrings(self, s: str) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        zero_pos = [i for i, ch in enumerate(s) if ch == '0']
        zero_pos.append(n)
        
        ans = 0
        z_idx = 0
        
        for i in range(n):
            while z_idx < len(zero_pos) - 1 and zero_pos[z_idx] < i:
                z_idx += 1
            
            # Substrings starting at i with zero zeros
            first_zero = zero_pos[z_idx]
            ans += first_zero - i
            
            # Substrings with z zeros (z >= 1)
            k = 1
            while z_idx + k - 1 < len(zero_pos) - 1:
                cur_z = k
                if cur_z * cur_z + cur_z > n - i:
                    break
                p = zero_pos[z_idx + k - 1]
                next_p = zero_pos[z_idx + k]
                min_len = cur_z * cur_z + cur_z
                start_j = max(p, i + min_len - 1)
                if next_p > start_j:
                    ans += next_p - start_j
                k += 1
                
        return ans
```

variables: n: length of binary string s
complexity.notes: Zero count loop is bounded by sqrt(n) iterations per starting index.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all O(n^2) substrings causes quadratic time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory stores zero index list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes sqrt(n) bound on zeros and counts endpoints using precomputed zero indices.
